title: Sikka language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Flores, Indonesia
extract: The Sikka language or Sikkanese, also known as Sika, is spoken by around 180,000 people of the Sikka ethnic group on Flores island in East Nusa Tenggara province, Indonesia. It is a member of the Central Malayo-Polynesian branch of the Austronesian language family.
